scenes.text: Michael De Santa's grave has someone else inside it.
Nine years earlier, Michael secretly sold out his own crew to the FIB to escape his criminal life.
During their last robbery in North Yankton, his partner Brad was shot and killed.
Trevor believed Brad was locked away in prison all those years.
But that's not the worst part. When Trevor finally dug up Michael's grave in Ludendorff, Brad's body was inside.
Michael's perfect new life had been built on his partner's grave.
